mapper.sql: alert_id, fingerprint, alertname, status, site_id, room_id, labels, annotations, started_at, ended_at, created_by, created_at, created_ip, updated_by, updated_at, updated_ip
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alert_log ( fingerprint, alertname, status, site_id, room_id, labels, annotations, started_at, ended_at, created_by, created_at, created_ip, updated_by, updated_at, updated_ip ) VALUES ( #{fingerprint}, #{alertname}, #{status}, #{siteId}, #{roomId}, #{labels}, #{annotations}, #{startedAt}, NULL, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{createdIp}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedAt}, #{updatedIp} ) ON CONFLICT (fingerprint) WHERE status = 'FIRING' DO UPDATE SET annotations = EXCLUDED.annotations, labels = EXCLUDED.labels, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at, updated_ip = EXCLUDED.updated_ip
mapper.update: UPDATE alert_log SET status = 'RESOLVED', ended_at = #{endedAt}, annotations = #{annotations}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp} WHERE fingerprint = #{fingerprint} AND status = 'FIRING'
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM alert_log
ORDER BY started_at DESC, alert_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
